description: Pinned, local-only DeepSeek Harness plugin-composition fixture. The requested four-plugin bundle is evaluated fail-closed when a member does not implement the standard dsh.bundle contract.

assembly.input_policy: fixed source checkouts plus local tarballs/workspace links; no live registry

E1.name: plugin ABI and version ledger
thresholds: core and every requested plugin commit/version/package identity recorded at 100%
fresh profile boot/dump is reproducible from the pinned local inputs
a requested member without dsh.bundle is an explicit fail, never an implicit fallback

E2.name: provenance and install safety
thresholds: unallowlisted source or package count is 0
license, dependency, lifecycle-script, credential and network declarations are recorded
runtime evaluation performs no registry install, external network, real credential or external effect

E3.name: C2/C4 safety and side-effect parity
thresholds: critical interception 100%
unauthorized execution 0
unsafe duplicate effect 0
unknown effect is safe-stopped and never automatically retried

E4.name: C3/C5/C6 capability parity
thresholds: valid idempotent effect 1 and duplicate extra effect 0
silent semantic provider switch 0 and fallback reason recording 100%
simulated replay 5/5 and unapproved live effect 0

E5.name: small-team lifecycle and exit
thresholds: fresh install <= 90 minutes
upgrade, backup/restore and prepared-fault diagnosis each <= 30 minutes
resident services <= 3 and no extra specialist
uninstall leaves no hidden remote task, webhook, backup or credential

E6.name: non-duplicate composition benefit
thresholds: same task set, Provider and owner contract as the Codex comparison
at least one measurable, reproducible, non-duplicate advantage
E1-E5 all pass before any replacement or parallel-main decision

non_claims: A standard bundle or profile dump pass does not prove C2-C7 or product readiness.
A dynamic-plugin member is not interchangeable with a dsh.bundle member without a separately reviewed adapter.
A package hash paired with a source commit is not, by itself, source-to-binary reproducible-build provenance.
This fixture does not evaluate the real Provider, real credentials, remote data retention, or external effects.
